# `armada space`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armada.md)

Spaces hold apps, jobs, secrets, domains, and volumes (ADR 0026). Names only
need to be unique within a space. Every cluster has the space default,
which holds everything deployed without --space.

Commands work in the space `armada space use` saved, or the one --space
(or ARMADA_SPACE) names, else default. An app of another space can also
be named NAME.SPACE, which is how events and the internal host name
(NAME.SPACE.internal) show it. Lists take -A for every space.

On a cluster with a cluster network, containers reach other apps only
through their internal names, resolve only their own space's names, and
the containers of every space but default are kept away from the nodes,
the private network, and the cloud's metadata service (network isolation;
for default, turn it on with `armada space set default --network-isolation`).

Also: `spaces`.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`armada space create`](#armada-space-create) | Create a space |
| [`armada space delete`](#armada-space-delete) | Delete an empty space |
| [`armada space list`](#armada-space-list) | List spaces |
| [`armada space set`](#armada-space-set) | Change a space's settings |
| [`armada space show`](#armada-space-show) | Show a space's settings |
| [`armada space use`](#armada-space-use) | Work in a space: commands without --space use it |

## `armada space create`

Create a space.

```
armada space create NAME
```

## `armada space delete`

Delete a space. It must be empty: delete its apps, jobs, secrets, and
volumes first. The default space cannot be deleted.

```
armada space delete NAME
```

Also: `rm`.

## `armada space list`

List spaces.

```
armada space list [flags]
```

Also: `ls`.

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |

## `armada space set`

Change a space's settings (cluster-admin only).

--network-isolation keeps the space's containers away from the nodes, the
control plane, the private network, and the cloud's metadata service: they
reach the internet, their node's DNS server, and internal and public
ingress (ADR 0026). Every space but default always has it; turn it on for
default once its apps no longer need the private network. It needs the
cluster network.

```
armada space set NAME --network-isolation[=false] [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--network-isolation` | keep the space's containers away from the platform and the private network |

## `armada space show`

Show a space's settings.

```
armada space show NAME [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |

## `armada space use`

Save NAME in the client config (--config) as the space commands work in when
neither --space nor ARMADA_SPACE names one. `armada space use default`
goes back to the default space.

```
armada space use NAME
```
